record.prompt: How many lines contain ERROR across all .log files under logs/, subdirectories included? Give me the number and the command you used.
record.final_answer:
5 lines.

Command used:

    grep -rc 'ERROR' --include='*.log' logs

Breakdown:
    logs/app-1.log           2
    logs/app-2.log           1
    logs/archive/app-0.log   2
    total                    5

All three files end with a newline, so the per-file counts sum exactly to the total (no risk of an unterminated last line being miscounted by `wc -l`). notes.txt was excluded by the `*.log` filter.
